verdict: Deterministic scorer, so repeats are identical. Wrench is 4.1% closer to the FP8 model overall (95% CI -0.052 to -0.027 KL), from the agentic-coding windows. On general text the other quant is slightly closer, and it predicts the actual next token better on six full-vocabulary windows (NLL 0.085 lower). KL is not task accuracy.

candidates.name: Best other public quant at this size (as of 2026-10-18)
